wholeSiteProvenanceOnly.semantics: Each current-path SHA must equal afterSha256; each exact retained predecessor byte file must equal beforeSha256. Compact root may resolve these SHA reads via explicit validated Site-source-context mapping only; never replace active gameplay scenario imports with archived scenario objects.

guardSemantics: New helper checks exact incoming parent hash for a listed changed path, returns exact successor hash, and passes unlisted paths through. Existing location-presentation-source-guard now composes it after the unchanged historical location manifest; no older manifest is rewritten. location-current-registry directly chains the new helper when reading the original location manifest.
lifecycleSemantics: Current ledger applies exactly eight before/after rows and asserts old row equality. Three unpublished retired rows stay retained in supersededUnpublishedRecipes plus immutable source delta. All older rows and original location-additions remain intact.
sameScenarioIdentityBoundary: v5 is unpublished. If it publishes before merge, issue a new scenario ID and revise the scoped ledger/world checks; no save migration is supplied.
